title: 7 EYES 7 WINDS 7 SCROLLS | MORNING PRAYER | APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN
paragraphs: There is a difference between a man who speaks because he has something to say and a man who speaks because heaven has opened and something must be released before the service ends. Tonight I am the second kind of man. I did not walk into this place with a sermon. I walked in with a burden and the burden has a title and the title is not mine. It was given seven eyes, seven wings, seven scrolls. sit down on the inside of you because we are not gathering for information tonight. We are gathering for alignment.

Somewhere between the first word I speak and the last prayer we pray, a file is going to be opened over your life that has been sealed since before you were formed. Put your hand on your chest. Feel that. That is not just your heartbeat. That is a summons. I want you to understand something before we go any further. There is a government in the unseen realm. And that government does not operate on noise. It operates on sight, breath, and record. Eyes to see what must be watched. Wind to move what must be moved.

Scrolls to record what must never be forgotten. Every man and woman in this house tonight is standing at the intersection of those three realities, whether you feel it or not. Zechariah 4:10 says, "The eyes of the Lord run to and fro throughout the whole earth." Not I eyes, not glancing, running. There is a seven-fold intensity of divine attention that has been assigned to certain seasons. And I sense we have crossed into one of those seasons tonight. Let the glory of God begin to settle in this room.

I am not interested in a service that entertains you. I am contending for a service that relocates you. There is a difference between clapping for a message and carrying a mandate out of a building. Tonight you will carry a mandate. 2 Chronicles 16:9 says, "The eyes of the Lord run to and fro throughout the whole earth to show himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him." Notice something here. The eyes are not merely watching. They are watching in order to act.

They are searching in order to show strength on someone's behalf. This is not divine surveillance for the sake of judgment alone. This is divine surveillance for the sake of intervention. Somebody in this place has a heart that is not perfect in the sense of being flawless, but perfect in the sense of being wholly turned toward God, sincerely turned even in weakness.

And I want you to know that the same eyes that run to and fro are running specifically to locate you, to show yourself strong on your behalf in an area you thought had been forgotten. Revelation 5:6 describes a lamb standing as though it had been slain. having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of God sent out into all the earth. Church, read that again in your spirit. Sent out. Not sitting in heaven admiring you from a distance.

Sent out, dispatched, in motion, moving across the earth on assignment. The eyes of God are not passive observation. They are active pursuit. Somebody here has been asking, "Does God still see me?" I have a word for you. The same sevenfold eyes that are attached to the slain and risen lamb are the eyes currently located you in the room you are sitting in right now. You are not lost. You are found. You are watched over. You are being tracked by mercy. Holy Spirit have your way.

I refuse to control what happens from here. Let every mask fall. Let every pretense break. Let the real cry of this congregation come up before you. Now there is something about the number seven in the language of heaven that man has tried to reduce to superstition. But it is not superstition. It is structure. Seven is the number of completion of a full cycle of a matter brought to its final form. When the spirit of God says seven eyes, he is not exaggerating for poetic effect.

He is describing total complete no blind spot surveillance over the affairs of his children. When he says seven winds, he's describing a fullness of movement. Not one direction, not one gust, but a completeness of divine breath capable of reaching every closed door of your life from every angle. And when he says seven scrolls, he's describing a completed record. Nothing left out, nothing forgotten, nothing lost in the archive of God concerning you.

I decree over somebody reading the atmosphere of this service right now, what the enemy said was lost concerning you is written in a scroll that has not yet been opened. Your file has not been closed. Hold your peace. Let us go into the wind for a moment because I sense there is a company of people here whose situation is not a sight problem or a record problem but a movement problem. You know the will of God. You have even seen the promise but nothing is moving.

John 3:8 says the wind blows where it wishes and you hear the sound of it but cannot tell where it comes from or where it goes. So is everyone who is born of the spirit. There is a wing quality to the spirit of God that refuses to be predicted by your logic and refuses to be summoned by your formula. But hear me, refusing to be predicted is not the same as refusing to blow. The wind still comes. Ezekiel chapter 37. In the valley of dry bones, the prophet was told to prophesy to the wind.

And the wind came from the four corners and breathed on the slain, and they lived and stood up an exceeding great army. If wind can raise an army out of a valley of bones, wind can raise your business out of the grave you buried it in, wind can raise your ministry out of the coma it has been in, wind can raise your marriage out of the silence that has been sitting on it for 3 years, come breath from the four winds, and breathe upon this lane. I call it done in the realm of the spirit.

I call the dead things in this house back to standing position. There is a company of scrolls in Revelation chapter 5 that no man in heaven or on earth or under the earth was found worthy to open until the lamb who was slain stepped forward. And when he took the scroll, heaven did not stay quiet. Four living creatures and 24 elders fell down before him and they sang a new song. because a worthy one had finally been found to release what had been sealed. I want you to understand the weight of that picture.

Some of what is sealed over your life cannot be opened by your striving, your connections, your certificate, your fasting alone. It can only be opened by the lamp. Which means tonight is not about your effort. It is about his worthiness being applied to your file. Somebody's business has been sealed for 6 years. I speak to the seal tonight in the name that is above every name. Break.

Somebody's academic scroll, somebody's visa scroll, somebody's ministry scroll, somebody's child scroll has been sealed by frustration and delay. I speak to every seal. Holding back your scroll. The lamb who was slain is worthy. And by his worthiness, I lose what has been bound. Hebrews 4:13 tells us that all things are naked and open to the eyes of him with whom we have to do. That means there is no version of your story that God has not already read. He is not surprised by your weakness.

He's not shocked by the mess in your finances or the wound in your marriage or the addiction you have not told anyone about. He has already seen it and he still assigns seven eyes to run to and fro on your behalf. That is not the description of a God who is disgusted with you. That is the description of a God who is pursuing you. I want to shift the atmosphere now because teaching alone will not deliver anybody. Stand to your feet if you can. Lift your hands not as a ritual but as a surrender.

Somewhere in this room, a woman has been carrying a burden for a womb that has refused to open for 11 years. Somewhere in this room, a young man has been carrying the burden of a calling he keeps running from because the assignment terrifies him. Somewhere in this room, a father is carrying guilt for a household. He feels he has failed. I am not calling out your name because I do not need to. Heaven already knows it and heaven already numbered it and the record is not finished. The ink is still wet on your chapter.

Habacook 2: es 2 and 3 says, "Write the vision and make it plain upon tables that he may run that readeth it. For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak and not lie. Though it tar, wait for it, because it will surely come, it will not tarry. Church, the delay you have been calling a denial is actually a scroll waiting for its appointed moment. God is not slow. God is not asleep. God is writing. And what he writes, he performs.

And what carries in your hand is still running toward you on his calendar. I decree over every dream that has been buried under delay. It is not dead. It is dormant. I decree over every assignment that looked like it failed. It did not fail. It was interrupted. And interruption is not termination. Let the fire fall now. Let the fire of the Holy Ghost fall on every stubborn situation represented in this room. I am not praying soft prayers tonight.

There is a warfare dimension to this hour and I will not apologize for it. Father, in the name that owns every knee in heaven and on earth and under the earth, we come boldly not because we are worthy but because the lamb who was slain is worthy and we stand in his worthiness. We ask you to release the sevenfold eyes of the spirit of God to locate every hidden thing working against the people in this room. Every altar raised against them in secret.

every plot formed in darkness, every council gathered against their peace, let those eyes run to and fro until every hidden weapon is found and exposed. I speak to every family line represented here tonight. There are patterns that have run in bloodlines for generations, patterns of poverty that skip no one. patterns of premature death, patterns of divorce, patterns of madness, patterns of baroness.

I decree by the eyes that run to and fro that every hidden pattern is now exposed and by the wind that blows where it wishes, every pattern is now scattered. And by the scroll that records what heaven has ordained, a new pattern of blessing is now written over this family line in Jesus name. Somebody's father's house has an altar that has never been dealt with. It was built before you were born, but you have been paying for it your whole adult life.

Every evil altar raised in the name of your family, whether by your grandfather, your great grandmother, or a hand you never even knew existed, I command fire to fall on that altar now. Let it be consumed. Let the smoke of that altar stop rising to any power in the second heaven from this night forward. Numbers chapter 23 23 declares that surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel. According to this time it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel.

What hath God wrought? I decree that word over you. There is no enchantment strong enough to hold what God has released. There is no divination powerful enough to reverse what heaven has already written concerning you. There is a household in this gathering tonight where peace has been rare. Where children fight without knowing why. Where a wife and a husband have become polite strangers under one roof. Where the joy that used to fill the sitting room now feels rehearsed instead of real.

I want you to know that some of what your household is experiencing is not merely emotional fatigue. It is spiritual residue from an inheritance you did not choose but were still handed. 2 Corinthians 5:17 says, "If any man be in Christ, he's a new creature. Old things are passed away. Behold, all things are become new." I decree that every household represented in this room is entering a genuinely new inheritance tonight. Not a patched version of the old dysfunction, but new.

New peace, new patience, new capacity to forgive quickly instead of storing offense for years. I speak to every child being raised in a home shaped by tension. I decree that the cycle stops with this generation. I decree that what your parents could not model for you, the Holy Spirit would teach you directly. I decree grace over every single parent in this room, carrying a double assignment alone. Grace to be both strength and softness. Grace to be provider and comforter.

Grace that does not run out by the time evening comes. Let us pray now for marriages because I sense heaviness in that specific area over some in this room. There is a woman here whose marriage has become a performance in public and a war zone in private. There is a man here who does not know how to say the words that would heal his home. So he has chosen silence instead. And the silence is doing more damage than the argument ever did. I speak to every marriage under siege tonight.

By the wind of the spirit that blew life into dry bones, breathe life back into what has gone cold. By the eyes that run to and fro, let every third party, every spiritual and physical interference, every soul tie assigned to destroy this covenant be exposed and dismantled by the scroll of God's original design for marriage. Let what man has done be rewritten in love, patience, and covenant fidelity. Malachi 2:16 says, "The Lord hates putting away, hates divorce, hates the covering of violence with one's garment."

I decree that violence, verbal, emotional, spiritual, physical, is removed from every home connected to this ministration tonight. I decree that every garment of offense covering unresolved wounds is stripped off and healing is applied directly to the wound instead of being buried under pride. There is also a financial dimension to this hour that I cannot ignore. Some of you have been faithful in the small and have not yet seen the multiplication of the larger.

I want to remind you of Malachi 3:10 where God says, "Bring the whole tithe into the storehouse that there may be food in my house and test me now in this if I will not open for you the windows of heaven and pour out a blessing that there will not be room enough to receive." Notice windows plural, not one window. This is consistent with the language of sevenfold fullness we have been speaking about all night. God does not open one window when he wants to bless a man who has been faithful in obscurity.

He opens windows. He releases wind. He releases eyes to locate the exact door that has been closing on your finances. And he records it in a scroll that cannot be reversed by any economic downturn, any betrayal, any scarcity mindset planted in you by your background. I speak to every financial gate that has been shut against you by covenant cause or carelessness. Open now in the name of Jesus. I speak to every contract that should have closed and did not. Every payment that should have arrived and was delayed.

Every business that should have expanded and instead contracted. I release the seven winds of increase upon you tonight. Let increase come from a direction you did not plan for. Let increase come from a source you have never met. Let increase come suddenly because that is how the wind operates. You hear the sound before you understand the origin. Deuteronomy 8:18 says, "Remember the Lord your God for it is he who gives you power to get wealth that he may establish his covenant."

This is not a chase after money for its own sake. This is a covenant matter. I decree that every hand assigned to this room tonight is reconnected to covenant wealth. Wealth with purpose. Wealth with destiny attached. Wealth that builds rather than destroys. Now let us turn our attention to health because there is a healing virtue that flows out from the throne. And I refuse to close this service without releasing it specifically. Somebody has a report in their body that does not match the report of the Lord.

Somebody has been managing a condition quietly telling no one. Smiling through Sunday service while carrying pain through the week. I speak directly to that body now by the stripes of Jesus Christ by which we were healed. According to Isaiah 53:5, I command every sickness assigned to steal your years to loosen his grip and leave. Psalm 103: ES 2-3 says, "Bless the Lord, oh my soul, and forget not all his benefits, who forgives all your iniquity, who heals all your diseases, all, not some."

I decree all sickness represented in this house tonight bows to the name of Jesus. I decree the wind of God moves through every organ that has been under attack. Every diagnosis that has frightened a family, every pain that has refused to respond to medication, breathe wind of God. Breathe healing into that body right now. There is somebody carrying a report from a hospital that they have not shown to anybody, not even the people closest to them, because they are still trying to process it alone.

I want you to know tonight that you do not have to process it alone. Heaven already has eyes on that file. Third John verse 2 says, "Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health even as thy soul prospers." Notice the order prosperity of health is tied to prosperity of soul. I decree that as your soul receives peace tonight, your body begins to align with that peace. I decree every symptom that has confused the doctors is not a mystery to the physician who formed you in the womb.

I decree clarity for every diagnosis still pending and I decree that when the results come back they will carry a testimony not a tragedy. There is also a mental and emotional exhaustion. I must speak to the kind that does not show up on any scan but sits behind the eyes of someone who has been strong for everyone else for too long. Matthew 11:28 says, "Come unto me all ye that labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest."

I decree rest, not the kind of rest that requires you to escape your life, but the kind that meets you inside your life and steadies you regardless of what is happening around you. Receive it now. There is also a time dimension I must address because I sense somebody here feels they have lost years they can never recover. Yes to addiction. Yes to a wrong relationship. Yes to depression. Yes to a prison sentence. Yes to a wrong decision made in youth.

Joel 2:2 says, "I will restore to you the years that the swarming locust has eaten the hopper, the destroyer, and the cutter. My great army which I sent among you." Notice restoration of years is described as a promise strong enough to reverse an entire army's worth of damage. If God can restore years eaten by an army of locusts, God can restore the years eaten by your own poor choices, your family's dysfunction, or an enemy's direct assault.

I decree tonight the years the locust ate are being restored, not in slow motion, not gradually stretched across another decade. I decree accelerated restoration. What took 10 years to destroy, God can restore in one season because he's not confined to the natural pace of loss. He restores at the speed of mercy. Somebody's virtue has been drained. You have given so much of yourself to people, to work, to ministry, to a demanding family that you feel like an empty container being asked to keep pouring.

Mark chapter 5 tells the story of a woman with an issue of blood who touched the hem of Jesus's garment and virtue went out from him and she was healed and he turned and asked who touched me because he perceived that virtue had gone out of him. I want you to know tonight that the same Jesus who felt virtue leave his body to heal a desperate woman is aware of the virtue that has left your body, your emotions, your spirit through years of pouring without being refilled. I decree virtue is restored to you now.

Strength is restored. Joy that was stolen by exhaustion is restored. You will not pour from an empty vessel any longer because heaven is feeling you even as I speak. Let us address witchcraft directly because pretending it does not exist does not make it stop operating. There is an assignment of witchcraft against destinies in this room not to frighten you but to arm you with the truth so you can war intelligently.

Numbers 23:23 already told us no enchantment can stand against a person carrying covenant but covenant people still need to actively resist. 1 Peter 5:8 says, "Be sober, be vigilant, because your adversary, the devil, walks about like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour."

I speak now to every witchcraft altar assigned against anyone in this room, whether in the village, in the family house, in the workplace, or in the spirit realm without a physical location by the eyes of the Lord that run to and fro, be exposed by the wind of the Holy Ghost. be scattered by the scroll of divine judgment be recorded as defeated to this night in the name of Jesus.

I decree that every arrow fired against your destiny between midnight and 4 in the morning, the hour the enemy loves to operate is returned to sender. I decree every dream where you were being chased, where you were losing your teeth, where you were eating in your sleep, where you saw yourself getting married to a stranger is now cancelled. And I decree the interpretation of every such dream is nullified by the blood of Jesus.

Let me speak now about angelic intervention because the same chapter that gave us the seven eyes also reminds us that angels are sent to minister for those who shall be heirs of salvation. According to Hebrews 1:14, I release angelic assignment over every person connected to this ministration tonight. Let angels be dispatched to go ahead of you into meetings you have not yet walked into. Let angels be dispatched to soften the heart of every gatekeeper standing between you and your breakthrough.

Let angels be dispatched to physically preserve you from accidents, ambush, and premature death. Psalm 91:11 says, "He shall give his angels charge over you, to keep you in all your ways. I decree divine preservation over every life in this room and every life connected to you by blood or assignment. No weapon formed against you shall prosper according to Isaiah 54:17 and every tongue that rises against you in judgment and you shall condemn.

This is your heritage as a servant of the Lord and your righteousness is of me says the Lord. I decree preservation over every traveler among us. those flying this month, those driving long distances for work, those relocating to a new city or a new country in search of a better portion. Psalm 121:8 says, "The Lord shall preserve your going out and your coming in from this time forth and even forever more. I decree your going out is covered, your coming in is covered, and everything in between is covered.

I decree that every scheduled accident, every planned ambush, every diversion prepared by darkness to intercept your movement is cancelled before it can be executed. I decree preservation over the minds of the young people in this house. That the pressure of comparison, the noise of a generation raised on other people's highlight rails will not be strong enough to convince a single one of them that their story is behind schedule. Your season is not late. It is timed differently and different is not inferior.

I want to bring us back to the scroll for a moment because there is a final piece of this puzzle I have not yet released. Ezekiel chapter 2 and 3 describe the prophet being handed a scroll and told to eat it. And it was written within and without with lamentations, mourning and woe. Yet when Ezekiel ate it, it was in his mouth as honey for sweetness. There is a scroll assigned to you that looks from the outside like a burden too heavy to carry.

But I decree tonight that when you finally receive what God is handing you, the very thing that look like sorrow on the surface will taste like sweetness in your mouth because hidden inside the hard assignment is the sweetness of purpose fulfilled. Somebody has been running from a scroll God tried to hand them years ago. You knew the call. You felt it as a teenager, as a young adult, maybe even recently in a dream. You dismiss as strange. I speak to that scroll tonight.

Return to the hand that was assigned to carry you. Return in Jesus' name. The running season is over. Let the declarations increase now because I feel the tempo of the spirit rising in this place. Declare with me out loud wherever you are. My eyes are opening to what God has always seen concerning me. My breakthrough is riding on a wind I cannot manufacture but I can receive it. My story is written in a scroll that cannot be edited by the enemy.

I decree that every silent sufferer in this room becomes a testimony before the end of this season. I decree that every prodigal being remembered tonight by a praying mother or father begins a journey home before the year runs out. I decree that every ministry gift buried under fear, comparison or past failure is exumed and activated. I decree that every business idea that look foolish to everyone around you is actually the wisdom of God wrapped in a strange package and it will prosper.

Isaiah 60:1 says, "Arise, shine for your light has come and the glory of the Lord is risen upon you. I decree arising over every person who has been sitting down on the inside for far too long. Sitting down in grief, sitting down in shame, sitting down in the exhaustion of waiting. Arise, your sitting season has expired. There is a woman in this house who has prayed for a child until she stopped believing her own prayers.

I speak to your womb tonight by the eyes that run to and fro, by the wind that gives breath to the breathless, by the scroll that recorded your name before the foundation of the world. Open. I decree the testimony that has tried is arriving on schedule and it will not be late. There is a young man carrying the weight of being the first in his family to break a cycle. The pressure feels unbearable some nights. I speak strength into you now. You are not alone in this assignment.

generations before you failed to break the cycle. Not because they were weaker than you, but because they did not have access to what you have access to tonight. The wind that is blowing in this room is blowing specifically to finish what your fathers could not finish. Receive it. I sense the spirit of God moving in short, sharp burst now. Words of knowledge one after another. I will not explain them. I will only release them and you will know if it belongs to you.

There is someone here who has been offered a position at work but has been afraid to accept it because you do not feel qualified. Take it. Grace has already gone ahead of you. There is a document sitting on someone's table right now unsigned and you have been delaying signing it out of fear. That fear is not from God. Sign it. Someone changed their phone number recently hoping to cut off a specific person permanently. I decree that decision is sealed by heaven and you will not be found by what you walked away from.

There is a man here who has been secretly saving money for a business he has told no one about. I decree the capital is coming faster than your business plan projected. Somebody buried a loved one this year and has not truly grieved because you have been holding the family together. I decree permission to grieve is released to you tonight and strength will meet you the moment you allow the tears.

There is a testimony connected to a letter, a letter you are waiting for, an admission letter, an approval letter, an offer letter. I decree that letter is already written. It is only in transit. Somebody has been having the same recurring dream about water. Either drowning or standing at the edge of an ocean unable to move. I decree that dream is broken tonight and I decree the fear attached to it loses its grip permanently.

There is a woman who stopped wearing her wedding ring months ago because of pain in the marriage. I decree restoration is closer than you think. Do not finalize in your heart what heaven has not finalized in the courts of eternity. Someone here has been quietly building an altar of bitterness against a sibling over an inheritance matter. I decree that bitterness is exposed and dealt with tonight before it costs you the relationship permanently.

There is a young woman who has been told by too many voices that she is too much, too intense, too passionate, too different. I decree that what they call too much, God calls exactly enough. Stop shrinking. Father, we thank you for what you are doing even now in ways some of us cannot yet feel with our natural senses. We thank you that the eyes you have sent out into all the earth are not roaming aimlessly but are precisely located over every person in this gathering.

We thank you that the wind you are releasing tonight is not confused wind, not random wind but purposeful wind, assigned wind, wind with our names written into its assignment. We thank you that the scrolls that concern us are safely kept in your hand and that no delay, no demonic interference, no human failure can erase what you have written. I release a final wave of prayer over every category we have not specifically named tonight but that heaven already knows about.

For the person battling thoughts they are ashamed to say out loud, peace in Jesus' name. For the person grieving someone they lost and pretending in public that they are find comfort in Jesus name. For the person about to make a decision that will alter the next 10 years of their life. Wisdom and clarity in Jesus name. For the person who feels forgotten by everyone including God. I remind you the eyes that run to and fro have never once lost sight of you.

Before we close, I want to speak one more time to the person who almost did not come tonight. The one who nearly stayed home because the weight of disappointment made it feel pointless to show up again. I am glad you did not listen to that voice. Lamentations 3: es 22 and 23 say, "It is of the Lord's mercies that we are not consumed because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning. Great is his faithfulness. Whatever exhausted you yesterday does not get to define what is available to you this morning.

Mercy did not run out. It renewed while you were sleeping and it is renewing again right now over you specifically. I decree that this ministration does not end when the last word is spoken. I decree it continues working quietly in your spirit over the coming days. The way a seed keeps walking on the ground long after the sewer has walked away from the field. You will not see everything change tonight. Some of it will unfold over the next weeks, some over the next months.

But I decree that the process has been initiated. And what has been initiated by the sevenfold eyes, the sevenfold wind and the seven-fold scroll of God cannot be aborted by human doubt or demonic resistance. Let the fire of God settle now, not as noise, but as fact. Let every person in this room walk out of here different from how they walked in. Let the seven eyes locate what needed to be found. Let the seven wings move what needed to be moved.

Let the seven scrolls release what needed to be written, sealed, and now spoken over your life. I decree over you in the fullness of this hour, what has been hidden is now seen. What has been stuck is now moving. What has been sealed is now open. Carry this out of this room the way you would carry fire carefully, deliberately, and without apology. Go in peace, but go changed. This is not the end of what God started tonight. This is only the release. The fulfillment is already being written.
